NOTE_phase1: Phase 1 — Built-in Microsoft login, no app registration needed. Any Microsoft account can log in.
NOTE_phase2: Phase 2 — Uncomment the 'auth' block below and fill YOUR_TENANT_ID + AAD_CLIENT_ID/SECRET to restrict to your org tenant only.

globalHeaders.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self' https://api.github.com https://login.microsoftonline.com; img-src 'self' https://avatars.githubusercontent.com data:

NOTE_phase2_instructions: Once AAD app registration is ready, add the block below (rename key to 'auth') and set AAD_CLIENT_ID + AAD_CLIENT_SECRET in Azure SWA > Configuration > Application settings
